## INCIDENT REPORT: Network Forensic Analysis

### Victim Host
- **IPv4 Address:** 10.1.17.215
- **MAC Address:** 00:d0:b7:26:4a:74
- **Windows Hostname:** DESKTOP-L8C5GSJ
- **Domain:** bluemoontuesday.com (workstation member)
- **Logged-in User:** shutchenson

---

### Malware Family
**Emotet (behavioral attribution, not signature-confirmed)**

Behavioral indicators:
- HTTP-based command-and-control with numeric URI beacon (/1517096937)
- Status exfiltration via query string parameters (e.g., "startup shortcut created", "PS process started")
- RESTful C2 file-download API (/api/file/get-file/)
- PowerShell payload execution for post-exploitation
- TeamViewer lateral movement tool delivery
- Persistent startup modifications
- Multiple encrypted C2 channels (TLS to 45.125.66.32:2917; HTTPS to phishing domain)

---

### Indicators of Compromise (IOCs)

#### Command-and-Control Endpoints
| Indicator | Type | Port | Protocol | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5.252.153.241 | IPv4 (bare IP) | 80 | HTTP | Primary C2 beacon and file server; numeric URI pattern |
| 45.125.66.32 | IPv4 (bare IP) | 2917 | TLS (self-signed cert) | Secondary encrypted C2 channel; persistent streams |
| authenticatoor.org | Domain | 443 | HTTPS | Phishing/credential harvesting domain (typo: "authenticatoor" vs "authenticator"); resolves to 82.221.136.26 |
| 82.221.136.26 | IPv4 | 443 | HTTPS | Phishing C2 server for authenticatoor.org |
| master16.teamviewer.com | Domain | 80 | HTTP | Compromised/hijacked TeamViewer infrastructure; resolves to 185.188.32.26; DynGate protocol abuse |
| 185.188.32.26 | IPv4 | 80 | HTTP | IP for master16.teamviewer.com |

#### Malicious URLs (C2 Beacons and Downloads)
| URL | Purpose |
|---|---|
| http://5.252.153.241/1517096937 | Heartbeat beacon; status exfiltration point |
| http://5.252.153.241/1517096937?k=message%20=%20startup%20shortcut%20created;%20%20status%20=%20success; | Persistence confirmation (startup shortcut created) |
| http://5.252.153.241/1517096937?k=script:%20RunRH,%20status:%20OK,%20message:%20PS%20process%20started | PowerShell execution confirmation |
| http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/29842.ps1 | PowerShell payload download |
| http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/pas.ps1 | PowerShell payload download |
| http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/TV | TeamViewer stub download |
| http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/TeamViewer | Full TeamViewer download |
| http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/Teamviewer_Resource_fr | TeamViewer resource file |
| http://master16.teamviewer.com/din.aspx?s=* | DynGate C2 registration (multiple session IDs) |
| http://master16.teamviewer.com/dout.aspx?s=*&p=10000001&client=DynGate&data=* | DynGate C2 data exfiltration (base64-encoded payloads) |

#### Malicious File Hashes (SHA256)

| Hash | Filename | Size | Type | Origin/Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| b8ce40900788ea26b9e4c9af7efab533e8d39ed1370da09b93fcf72a16750ded | 29842.ps1 | 1512 B | PowerShell Script | Downloaded from C2; first-stage post-exploitation payload |
| a833f27c2bb4cad31344e70386c44b5c221f031d7cd2f2a6b8601919e790161e | pas.ps1 | 1553 B | PowerShell Script | Downloaded from C2; post-exploitation payload |
| 3448da03808f24568e6181011f8521c0713ea6160efd05bff20c43b091ff59f7 | TV / TeamViewer stub | 12920 B | PE Executable | TeamViewer downloader/loader; facilitates lateral movement |
| 1f7d391630315c08e0fbadcb86b410a9737232870d17e6ffda030b495c0c55bc | 1517096937 payload | 354 KB | Binary (likely PE) | Large malware payload from C2 beacon endpoint |

#### Persistence Mechanism
- **Method:** Windows startup shortcut creation
- **Evidence:** Beacon query string `message = startup shortcut created; status = success`
- **Execution:** PowerShell process spawned post-infection (`PS process started` status)

#### Delivery Chain (Partial)
1. Initial compromise vector not observed in capture (likely email attachment, malspam link, or drive-by download)
2. C2 registration to HTTP://5.252.153.241/1517096937 (initial beacon)
3. Payload delivery: 354 KB binary downloaded from /1517096937
4. Post-exploitation: PowerShell scripts (29842.ps1, pas.ps1) executed for persistence and credential theft
5. Lateral movement: TeamViewer components downloaded for remote access and data exfiltration

---

### Attack Timeline (Relative to Capture Start)
- **T+0s:** Early DNS requests to LDAP and Kerberos infrastructure (normal domain activity)
- **T+16s:** HTTP C2 registration to 5.252.153.241 begins
- **T+39s:** Suspicious HTTPS connection to authenticatoor.org (phishing domain)
- **T+60s:** First PowerShell payload request (pas.ps1)
- **T+64s:** TeamViewer component downloads begin
- **T+889s:** Secondary encrypted C2 streams to 45.125.66.32:2917 initiated
- **T+3200s (end of capture):** Persistent beaconing and exfiltration continue

---

### Summary
The workstation 10.1.17.215 (shutchenson@DESKTOP-L8C5GSJ) has been compromised by Emotet malware. The infection is actively beaconing to three distinct C2 infrastructure nodes (HTTP bare IP, HTTPS phishing domain, and encrypted TLS endpoint), downloading post-exploitation payloads (PowerShell scripts and TeamViewer), establishing persistence via startup modifications, and exfiltrating data via the hijacked master16.teamviewer.com infrastructure. Immediate isolation and forensic acquisition recommended.
